items: [Immersive Sound with OrigX Acoustics] Powered by TOZO OrigX 2.0 acoustic tuning and an advanced 8 mm dynamic driver, T10 delivers deep bass, natural mids, and crisp highs. Whether you are listening to music, podcasts, or watching videos, every detail sounds clear and balanced.

[Comfortable Ergonomic Fit for All Day Wear] The lightweight ergonomic design follows the natural shape of the ear for a secure and pressure free fit. Multiple ear tip sizes help create a comfortable seal so you can wear the earbuds during commuting, workouts, or long listening sessions without discomfort.

[Up to 55 Hours of Total Playtime] Enjoy up to 15 hours of playtime on a single charge and up to 55 hours with the charging case. Designed for travel, daily commuting, and long listening sessions without frequent charging.

[Wireless Charging and Easy Power Up] The charging case supports convenient wireless charging. Simply place it on a compatible charging pad to power up without cables, making daily charging simple and clutter free.

[Custom Sound with the TOZO App] Use the TOZO App to personalize your listening experience with 32 EQ sound modes, white noise options, and customizable touch controls. Update firmware easily and adjust settings to match your music style and daily needs.
[IPX8 Waterproof with HydroGuard Technology] TOZO HydroGuard technology provides IPX8 waterproof protection against sweat, rain, and splashes. Ideal for running, workouts, and outdoor activities.

[Stable Bluetooth 5.3 Connection] Equipped with advanced Bluetooth 5.3 technology for fast pairing and stable connections. Enjoy smooth audio and reliable performance whether at home, in the office, or on the go.

[Smart Touch Control] The intuitive touch control design lets you play or pause music, answer calls, and adjust tracks without reaching for your phone, providing a simple and convenient listening experience.
[Clear Calls with Dual Microphones] Built in dual microphones help reduce background noise during calls, allowing your voice to sound clearer during meetings, phone calls, or video chats.

[Designed for Everyday Life] From commuting and workouts to relaxing at home, TOZO T10 earbuds are built for daily use. Enjoy comfortable wear, long battery life, and reliable performance wherever your day takes you.
